title: W1's open-data loads: a busy site is waited out, and every record a batch receives is accounted for
why: The launch plan's B.6 (#10) and B.7 (#11), which D.1's town loads wait on (decisions/0181; the session manager's order, 2026-11-27). #11: the ledger's warning '/api/crawl/loads: received 100, accounted for 80' came from the load's reply, not from lost records. OpenLoads::batch counted each record seen as skipped, closed, staged or listed, but left out two outcomes (a record folded into its twin in the same batch, ListingIdentity::fold; content the intake already has, IntakeStager::stage's already_known), and ControlLedger::counts read 'closed' (a closure signal on a listing we have) as nothing. Fixed at the cause: batch() also answers 'duplicates' and 'already_known' (refused, by reason, keys the ledger already reads), and the ledger reads 'closed' as updated, so received = accounted for, and the open warning clears itself on the next good call (ControlLedger's own clear). Places' 'closed' (/api/crawl/places) reads as updated too. #10 ships with it in the crawler worker 2.17.1 (workers/crawler, on main; Railway deploys it on merge): a load batch the host answers 502, 503 or 504 waits 30, 90 and 180 s and is sent again with its number (the same waits as Geofabrik's batches, 2.13.0, Jason 2026-11-19), so one 503 no longer fails the whole task (W1 run #2148); a wait past the task's time stops the town for this run (not marked done, handed out again; taken batches answer what they did), and the task reads idle with the reason, never failed. Backend only: nothing a visitor or the admin sees changes but the ledger's numbers adding up.

changes.what: A load's line in the Control Board's ledger adds up to what it received: closures as updated, twins in one batch and records already known as refused with their reason

checks.load-counts: tools/control-board-tests/load-counts.php 18 on MariaDB (the real OpenLoads::batch and ControlLedger::counts; the identity check and intake as stand-ins with known answers): 20 records through every route add up to 20 in the reply and in the ledger; a resent batch answers the same counts; its kept answer fits open_load_batches.result; places' closed reads as updated; W0's receipt read as before. On the live code 10 of the 18 fail (the defect reproduced).
checks.load-batches: tools/control-board-tests/load-batches.php 10/10 on the build (unchanged behaviour of batch numbers and the recheck).
checks.worker: workers/crawler/tests/test_load_batches.py 17/17: a 503 waited out and sent again with the same batch; four busy answers wait 30, 90, 180 then fail as before; a 500 or 422 isn't sent again; a wait past the task's time stops the town; the task reads idle with its reason. test_site_call, test_held_task, test_fallbacks, test_osm_places pass.
